scope: Proposition 8.4 of the manuscript “Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields” (preprints/Modularity-of-elliptic-curves-over-imaginary-quadratic-fields-October-4-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 030 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c74cc37755f500be), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 23. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let SK be a finite set of finite places of K containing all places above 3p. For each v0 ∈ SK, prescribe a nonempty open subset Ωv0 ⊂ U(Kv0 ). There exists a single t ∈ U(K) lying in every Ωv0 such that the following assertions hold over F = K(µ3p). 1. For each (m, ℓ) in (8.1) and each character θ of order m, the representation V θ,ℓ is absolutely irreducible on GF(ζℓ) and is decomposed generic. 2. The representation V 1,p has these same two properties at p. 3. The elliptic curve At = Jac(C3(t)/⟨w⟩) is non-CM. In particular, when the opens above 3p are those of Proposition 7.5, this same parameter also satisfies all the local conclusions of Corollary 7.6.
